This is the all-new Kia PV5!
It’s Kia’s very first dedicated electric van-meets-MPV, built on a modular "Platform Beyond Vehicle" setup, and it’s aiming straight for the Volkswagen ID. Buzz!
Is this futuristic Korean EV practical enough for everyday family life and business, or is it just a sci-fi concept with sliding doors? I’m going to review it to find out!
